thread:
Jana (Partnerships): Quick sync — proposing a holiday SMB migration promo: 3 months of quickstart credits + optional HW co-fund for appliance customers. Goal = accelerate BYO migration before Q1 renewals. Thoughts? :santa:

Kevin (Sales): Love it. SMBs respond to time-limited $0 friction offers. Can we make co-fund conditional on a 12mo committed conversion?

Tess (Finance): Need target % conversion and expected uplift to model P&L. Rough ask: what does 3mo credit cost us vs incremental ARR if 30% convert at renewal?

Omar (Ops): Heads-up on capacity — appliance onboards spike our provisioning. If we run a promo we need a fast-track SLA for the first 2 weeks or we'll blow lead times.

Sasha (SI): SI readiness is crucial. We can offer 2 training hours + migration playbook per customer. For co-fund, SI can take a $1k delivery credit on our side to offset time.

Ali (HW): From hardware side we can co-fund up to 20% of appliance invoice for new SMBs, but needs PO in marketplace private-offer flow. Logistics: serials + invoice matching.

Jana (Partnerships): Proposal for structure — A/B test two bundles across a small seller cohort (50 deals):
- Variant A: 3mo Redwood credit ($3k cap) + SI quickstart (2h)
- Variant B: 3mo Redwood credit ($3k cap) + HW co-fund 15% + SI quickstart
Renewal sweetener: remaining unused credits can be converted into committed consumption credit if they sign a 12mo private-offer within 60 days of promo end.

Kevin (Sales): Pricing suggestion: offer private-offer with a 12% discount for the 12mo commit conversion. That makes math simple for reps.

Tess (Finance): Run numbers on 3 scenarios please: 20% conv, 30% conv, 40% conv. Also include cost of SI credits and HW co-fund. I'll need an IRR table for the cohort.

Lia (Legal): Two items: 1) marketplace private-offer T&Cs need explicit language for credit conversion and pro-rata invoice adjustments; 2) ensure co-fund doesn't create reseller obligations. I'll draft a clause.

marketplace-bot: Draft private-offer created: PO#MP-17689-DRAFT by Jana. Link: https://marketplace.redwood/internal/offers/MP-17689 (draft)

Omar (Ops): If we enable co-fund path, add a flag in onboarding: "requires-hw-serial" and a small job to reconcile co-fund payouts weekly. Ops can support but need +1 head during promo.

Sasha (SI): Suggest adding a "faststart" checkbox in the SI console so partners can opt into priority slots; reduces friction. Also propose a one-pager playbook we can attach to the private-offer link.

Ali (HW): We'll need a minimal clip invoice template and swimlane for finance reconciliation. I can share sample CSV format.

Jana (Partnerships): Ok next steps: 1) Tess runs the 3-scenario financial model; 2) Lia drafts conversion & co-fund clause; 3) Omar and Sasha scope the fast-track + SI checklist; 4) Kevin picks initial 50-deal seller cohort and messaging. Can we aim to have the draft offer live by next Wed?

Kevin (Sales): Yes, will nominate cohort by EOD Tue.

Tess (Finance): I'll have the model by Tuesday afternoon.

Lia (Legal): Draft ready for review Tuesday.

Omar (Ops): Ops runbook + headcount ask by Tuesday as well.

Jana (Partnerships): Great — I'll update the draft in the marketplace and tag everyone. Quick note: let's include a short experiment metric set: activation (30d), conversion-to-commit (90d), average deal size uplift. Keep it lean. :white_check_mark:

Kevin (Sales): :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: review meeting Tues 2pm PST.

Jana (Partnerships): Thanks all — talk Tuesday.
